name: Promarine Collagen Tripeptides
headline: Promarine Collagen Tripeptides
howToUse: Adults – 1 bottle a day in the morning with food. Course: 30 days.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Liquid hydrolysed fish collagen (incl. MaxiCollagen 3.5 g) 15 g, hibiscus flower extract (Hibiscus sabdariffa) 1.5 g, white currant extract (Ribes rubrum) 700 mg, vitamin C (ascorbic acid) 100 mg, hyaluronic acid (sodium hyaluronate) 72 mg, vitamin B6 1.8 mg, vitamin B2 1.7 mg, biotin.
